violations.why: irq_velvet (prio 4) can preempt irq_loom between its read and write of v_ember, so the increment is lost.
irq_velvet can reset v_ember to 0 after loom's write. The check at line 21 then sees 0 and takes a branch that would not otherwise be reachable.
irq_velvet can change v_ember between loom's two reads.
irq_loom (prio 3) can preempt irq_bluff after its write of 0 and change v_ember. The check at line 29 then sees a different value.
irq_reef (prio 3) can preempt irq_bluff and set v_ember to 1. The check at line 29 then sees 1.
irq_velvet (prio 4) can preempt irq_bluff between its write and its read of v_ember. This is the same shape as the other write-write-read cases.
